name: triple-calendar
description: A date-picker calendar variant displaying three consecutive months.

anatomy.name: container
anatomy.description: Root of the legacy holder. Its minimum width and minimum height records are pinned to this file by their legacy keys; the calendar parts live on calendar.

anatomyReview.notes: A9 (2026-11-21), owner decision C2: a frozen legacy holder (three months), not deprecated. calendar is the only anatomy (option visibleMonths). The two legacy records keep their keys and move from part popover to container; no Figma, RSP or SWC source draws this component on its own. Same precedent as color-control.
